name: 79L05
description: Negative-rail 5V fixed linear regulator, 100mA, in TO-92. The low-power negative counterpart to the 78L05; typically paired with a positive regulator (e.g. 7805/78L05) to make a dual analog supply. TO-92 pin order (datasheet numbering) is GND(1)/VIN(2)/VOUT(3), which is the REVERSE of the positive 78Lxx.

TO-92.ascii:
╭───╮
    │   │   (flat face toward you, leads down)
    ╰─┬─╯
   │  │  │
 VOUT VIN GND
  (3) (2) (1)
TO-92.notes: datasheet numbers the leads GND=1, VIN=2, VOUT=3, drawn as a bottom view. Held flat-face-toward-you with leads down (front view), the physical left-to-right order is VOUT, VIN, GND (the reverse). The ascii above is the front view.

extra.Rth(JA): 232 C/W still air (88 C/W at 400ft/min airflow)

typical_application: Local on-card -5V rail for dual-supply op-amp / analog circuits, paired with a positive 5V regulator on the other rail.
gotchas: TO-92 order GND/VIN/VOUT is the REVERSE of the positive 78L05 (OUT/GND/IN); swapping a 78L for a 79L in the same footprint applies reverse polarity and destroys the part
it is a NEGATIVE regulator: VIN, VOUT and the regulated rail are all negative with respect to GND
the datasheet TO-92 figure is a bottom view; read it as a front view and you mirror the pins
